title: Clock spacing for two-sided Jacobi matrices
summary: We study local eigenvalue spacing for finite truncations of a two-sided Jacobi matrix with two movable endpoints. In particular, we show that a suitable analog of clock spacing follows from a pointwise reflectionlessness condition. We obtain this as a consequence of a new scaling limit for Christoffel--Darboux kernels with a movable starting point. Without reflectionlessness, we obtain a new class of limit kernels, which combine distinct contributions from $\pm\infty$.
